series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction and moderate seasonality, but high spectral entropy indicates unpredictable noise. Unstable model rankings and significant RMSE variation suggest using a robust baseline method like median aggregation to avoid overfitting to noisy or drifting patterns.

reasoning.robust_median: series_profile.noise.unpredictable=true AND spectral_entropy=0.8109 → high noise level; robust_median is recommended to avoid outlier sensitivity
reasoning.trimmed_mean_r0.10: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=-0.0877) → unstable rankings; trimmed_mean with moderate trim_ratio=0.10 balances robustness and model diversity
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rmse_spread_ratio=0.6675 AND rankings_stable=false → significant performance variation; inverse RMSE weights with shrinkage=0.35 (recommended_knobs) adapts to unstable rankings
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → per-horizon selection captures differentiated model performance across forecast horizons
